title: Sync
description: What the synchronization with the remote repository of the process did inside a command. Only the fields with something to tell are present.

received.description: Kinds changed on another machine and taken.

sent.description: Kinds changed on this machine and sent.

conflicts.description: Kinds changed on both machines that could not be brought together: the variant of the other machine is active, the changes of this machine are a draft.

restored.description: Kinds changed around Gentry with problems: the last checked variant is active again, the change is a draft.

unavailable.description: Present and true if the remote repository did not answer: the command worked with what the machine has.
